sentences.text:
The Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (hereinafter referred to as "Cr.P.C., 1973") has been filed on behalf of the petitioners, seeking to quash the FIR No. 0162/2018,
registered under Sections 406/498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereinafter referred to as "IPC, 1860") and Section 4 Dowry Prohibition Act at Police Station K.N. Katju Marg, Delhi.

2. Brief facts of the case are that the marriage was solemnized between petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 on 08.02.2015, according to Hindu rites and ceremonies and two children was born out of the said wedlock.

sentences.text: Thereafter the respondent No.2 lodged a complaint against the petitioners before CAW Cell and on the basis of said complaint an FIR bearing No. 0162/2018 under Sections 406/498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 4 Dowry Prohibition Act got registered at Police Station K.N. Katju Marg.

4. It is stated that the petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 have amicably settled all the disputes and differences between them and arrived at Settlement in 2021 and they have been living together since then.

5. The respondent No.2/wife has filed an affidavit of No Objection submitting that due to some temperamental issues between her and petitioner No.1/husband the FIR was registered and the matter has now been settled and they both are residing together as husband and wife.

It is further stated that she has no objection if the present FIR No.0162/2018 dated 13.05.2018 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 Dowry Prohibition Act registered at K.N. Katju Marg is quashed.
6. In view of the Settlement arrived at between the parties in 2021, the present petition has been filed for quashing of FIR.
7. The parties are present before this Court through Video Conferencing, and have been identified by their counsel and Investigating Officer concerned.
8. The respondent No.2/wife has endorsed the affidavit of No Objection for quashing of FIR and that the settlement has been arrived at without any fear, pressure and coercion.
The parties have submitted that all the disputes have been amicably settled and thus, no fruitful purpose will be served in
This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 14/08/2024 at 22:13:03 continuing with the FIR.
9. The present petition has been signed by all the petitioners and is supported by their respective affidavits.

10. In view of the above facts that the parties have amicably resolved their differences out of their own free will and without any coercion and also the fact that the present matter is a family matter,
no useful purpose will be served in continuing with the proceedings, rather the same would create further acrimony between them.
Hence, it would be in the interest of justice to quash the abovementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
11. Moreover, there is no legal impediment in quashing the FIR in question.

12. Accordingly, FIR No. 0162/2018 for the offence punishable under Sections 406/498A/34 of IPC,
1860, registered at Police Station
K.N. Katju Marg
and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
